host_packet_audit.finite_formula: u=X/W; v=Y/W; ex=1-abs(clamp(u,-2,2)*0.5); ey=1-abs(clamp(v,-2,2)*0.5); fade=1 if FSDc>distance else 1-((distance-FSDc)/(effectiveEnd-FSDc)); length=(((ex*Len)*ey)*fade); center=(u*0.5+0.5,0.5-v*0.5); IR=MAXSS(+0,IRad); OR=ORad if COMISS(IR,ORad)/JB else ADDSS(IR,epsilon).
